requestEvidence.text:
user's note: make a great video from these

canvas: 1920x1080 at 24 fps (YouTube 16:9 · 1080p; the footage's own rate, keep it). job folder: @RUN-TH-2-16:9@

files:
- @SOURCE-TH-2-1@ (video, 40.0 s)

edit like a top youtube editor (the result must look professionally edited, not auto-generated):
- hook: the first 2-3 s decide retention. start on speech or the most striking moment, never on dead air. put a 3-6 word hook on its own top track in the first 2.5 s with add_title style "hook_box" (short, specific, curiosity, no clickbait lies).
- pacing: auto_rough_cut every talking clip in story order with max_pause 0.3 and pad 0.05; read the returned segments and re-run with drop [{asset_id,index}] for false starts, repeats and filler-only segments (um, uh, like).
- energy: add_punch_ins on the talking track (pattern alternate, scale 1.15, focus on the face) for jump-cut rhythm. if there are extra non-speech video files, place_broll them over the talking track (min_shot 1.2, max_shot 3).
- captions: auto_captions style "pop", max_words_per_line 3, keywords true, highlight true, position auto, hint = names/terms from the note. captions must stay inside the title-safe area.
- look: auto_grade every media clip (style strength as given). never stack two grades.
- sound: finish_audio last with target_lufs -14 (music under speech -16 db when there is music). the app enforces true-peak -1 dBTP on delivery.
- before "done": run lint_edit (platform none) and fix what it reports, then timeline_summary to confirm.
- style for this video: Auto (kimo picks) — pick the treatment that best fits the footage and the note.
- quality over busyness: every element must serve the viewer. no overlapping texts, no text over faces.

tools (* = required):
project_set(fps:number, height:number, name:string, width:number) — Canvas and frame rate. A 9:16 short: {width: 720, height: 1280, fps: 30}. Call first.
import_media(path*:string) — Import a video or audio file by absolute path. Returns asset_id, duration, width, height.
auto_rough_cut(asset_ids*:array, dedupe:boolean, drop:array, max_pause:number, pad:number, soft:string, start:number, track_id:string) — Talking-head clips back to back with dead air cut out. Leave out a false start with drop [{asset_id, index}]. Returns ids.
place_broll(asset_ids*:array, end:number, in_points:object, max_shot:number, min_shot:number, start:number, track_id*:string, volume:number) — B-roll over the dialogue only while someone speaks, cut on pauses, b-roll muted. Returns ids.
cut_to_beat(asset_ids*:array, beats_per_shot:number, duration:number, in_points:object, music_asset_id*:string, start:number) — Music reel: lays the music and cuts the shots on its beats. Returns ids.
stabilize(clip_id*:string, framing:string(stabilize_only|crop|crop_auto_scale|synthesize_edges), lock:boolean, max_features:number, method:string(position|position_scale_rotation|perspective), mode:string(smooth_motion|no_motion), rolling_shutter:number, rotation:boolean, smooth:number, smoothing:string(gaussian|l1), smoothness:number, synthesis_range:number) — Steady a shaky media clip. Call after its in_point and duration are final.
auto_grade(clip_ids:array, strength:number, target_luma:number) — Fix exposure and colour cast per clip (dark, blown, blue or orange shots). Default: every clip.
add_title(accent:array, color:array, duration:number, font:string, start:number, style*:string(cinematic|impact|lower_third|kinetic|elegant|neon|hook_box|subscribe_pop), subtitle:string, text*:string, track_id*:string) — Title card: {track_id, style: "impact", text, start, duration}. Put it on its own top track.
add_text(align:string(left|center|right), anchor:string(center|left|right), color:any, duration*:number, font:string, letter_spacing:number, shadow:number, size:number, start*:number, stroke_color:any, stroke_width:number, text*:string, track_id*:string, x:number) — Text clip: {track_id, text, start, duration, size}. Move it with set_property y (pixels from centre, + is down).
caption_from_words(by_asset:object, check_confidence:boolean, hint:string, lines:number, max_chars:number, model:string, platform:string, size:number, style:string, text:string, track_id*:string, whisper_bin:string) — Captions from the words you give, timed to the speech, clear of the TikTok/Reels buttons. Best: by_asset {asset_id: words}.
auto_captions(active_color:any, clip_ids:array, color:any, fast:boolean, font:string, highlight:boolean, hint:string, keyword_color:any, keywords:boolean, language:string, lines:number, max_words_per_line:number, normalize_spelling:boolean, overwrite:boolean, position:string(auto|bottom|middle|top), replace:string, script:string(roman|native), size:number, srt_path:string, style:string(pop|karaoke|clean|boxed|impact), vtt_path:string, words:array) — Captions from kimo's own speech recognition: {clip_ids: [...rough-cut segments...]}. Use with no trustworthy transcript. Flags low-confidence words.
edit_caption(clip_id*:string, duration:number, start:number, text:string) — Change one caption cue's text: {clip_id, text}.
finish_audio(keep_ambience:boolean, music_clip_ids:array, music_under_speech_db:number, target_lufs:number) — Final mix in one call: clean dialogue, b-roll sound off, music under speech, -14 LUFS. Call before export.
lint_edit(dialogue_track:string, duration:array, platform:string, target_lufs:number) — Check the edit before export. Lists each problem with the exact call that fixes it. Fix, then run it again.
timeline_summary() — The edit at a glance: tracks bottom to top, each clip's id, source, start and end.
add_track() — New track on top (higher tracks draw over lower ones). Returns track_id.
add_clip(angle:number, asset_id:string, color:any, color2:any, duration*:number, fit:string(contain|cover|stretch), gradient:string(linear|radial), in_point:number, source_type*:string(media|solid|gradient), speed:number, start*:number, track_id*:string) — One media clip: {track_id, source_type: "media", asset_id, start, duration, in_point, fit: "cover"}.
trim_clip(clip_id*:string, duration:number, in_point:number) — Change a clip's in_point and/or duration.
move_clip(clip_id*:string, start*:number) — Move a clip to a new start time.
delete_clip(clip_id*:string) — Remove a clip.
set_property(clip_id*:string, property*:string(opacity|x|y|scale|rotation|rot_x|rot_y|pos_z|backface|fill_alpha|stroke_alpha), value*:number) — Set x, y, scale, opacity or rotation on a clip (x/y in pixels from centre).
set_audio(clip_id*:string, compress:boolean, denoise:number, echo:number, fade_in:number, fade_out:number, highpass:number, lowpass:number, mute:boolean, pitch:number, reverse:boolean, volume:number) — A clip's sound: mute, volume (1 = unchanged), fade_in, fade_out.
undo(steps:number) — Undo the last change. A recipe call (auto_*, place_broll, finish_audio) is one step.
add_smart_punch(clip_id*:string, motion:number, samples:integer, zoom:number) — Automatic subject-follow punch-in: a continuous zoom that centres on wherever the saliency map says the eye goes. {clip_id, zoom}.
add_glow_text(color:array, duration:number, font:string, glow_color:array, pulse_hz:number, size:number, start:number, text*:string, track_id*:string) — A title clip with a pulsing neon glow pre-applied: one call for the caption/hook look. {track_id, text, start, duration}.
auto_reframe(clip_id*:string, motion:string(static|slow|default|fast), remove:boolean, x:number, y:number) — Crop a clip to the canvas aspect (e.g. 16:9 into 9:16), following its subject. The fix lint_edit names for aspect_mismatch.
add_punch_ins(base_scale:number, clip_ids:array, ease:number, focus:array, pattern:string(alternate|all), remove:boolean, scale:number, start:string(wide|tight), track_id:string) — Jump-cut punch-ins: alternate a track's clips between wide and zoomed around a focus point (talking-head style).
sam_reframe(file*:string, prompt:string, punch_ins:array) — Meta SAM 3.1 tracks the subject (default "person"; or a noun like "dog") and renders the clip at the canvas aspect with a smoothed crop that follows it; punch_ins [{start,end,zoom 1.1-1.5}] zoom in centred on the subject (true = automatic). returns a NEW asset_id: add_clip it instead of the original (fit cover). use it instead of auto_reframe when the canvas aspect differs from the footage and the subject moves.
sam_text_behind(file*:string, text*:string, prompt:string, text_start:number, text_end:number, color:string) — big title placed BEHIND the subject (SAM matte), reframed to the canvas. 1-2 words. returns a NEW asset_id to add_clip instead of the original.
sam_background(file*:string, mode*(blur|color|image), color:string(#rrggbb), image:string(path), prompt:string) — keeps the subject sharp and blurs/replaces the background. returns a NEW asset_id.
sam_redact(file*:string, prompt*:string) — blurs every matching object (e.g. "face", "license plate", "logo"). returns a NEW asset_id.
sam_* tools are slow-ish (upload + track): call each at most once per file, before captions, and only when the note or the footage calls for it. file = one of the file paths above.
